notes: Published title 'Bring Him Up The Anus' is crude, so the page is titled by the player (DS); the post's title is kept in the source citation.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place (posted 'BHBM/TYFP'), Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points ('Mob Points'), Prepared Defenses and Death Star II: Throne Room ('Throne Room'); these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty. Total 60.
'Sevens (14)' is a section header (the 14 destiny-7 cards listed under it), not a card; it was dropped.
Posted 'Spaceport Dbay' dested Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark); 'DS2 Dbay' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'CC Dbay' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (the Dark Cloud City docking bay).

Posted 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'EPP Boba Fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (the strategy calls him 'Fett with Gun'); 'G.A. Thrawn' Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Zuckus in Mist Hunter' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.

Posted 'Control/Set For Stun' dested Control & Set For Stun; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Emporers power' Emperor's Power; 'Visage of the Emporer' Visage Of The Emperor; 'Intruder Missile' the Dark Intruder Missile page.
The post says the deck went 2-1 (losing only to Hidden Base X-wings); no event is named. Its postscript says 'Baroni obviously made me this deck'.
